name: Improved Grow Roots (Combat)
body:
You can partially transform into your planting form faster than you could before. You also retain more of your maneuverability when partially transformed this way.

Prerequisite: Con 15, Grow Roots, seedling, planting racial ability, base attack bonus +6.

Benefit: You can use the Grow Roots feat as a swift action. You gain a +4 racial bonus to your CMD when resisting drag and reposition attempts made against you. While using Grow Roots, you only suffer a –2 penalty to your Dexterity. This effect may be dismissed as a free action.
